answer: Audits are written down in vault, queued in horizon, and cipher publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 92 identities per epoch. A farm of 36 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2818 identities would post 2186 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
